newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to enforce bankruptcy act.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to enforce bankruptcy act.

text.p: Bangladesh will enforce a Bankruptcy Act from August to erase the continuing problem of loan defaults, The Financial Express newspaper reported on Wednesday.
A government-appointed committee was working on formulating rules and regulations for implementation of the law, the newspaper said, quoting government officials.
The officials said special courts would be set up in each of the 64 districts for the disposal of bankruptcy cases.
The act was passed in parliament on March 11 to address the problem of a huge amount of defaults on bank loans by companies, currently estimated at 135 billion taka ($3 billion).
Under the new act, a court may declare a borrower which defaults on a loan bankrupt, helping creditors realise their dues by attaching properties of the defaulters.
